Animate the dynamics of a food web

Source: R/food_web_plot.R
animate_food_web.Rd

Writes a GIF in which the trajectories from food_web_dynamics() unfold over time, one frame per time step shown, with the panels and axes of plot.food_web(). It needs the package gifski.

Usage

animate_food_web(
  x,
  file = "food_web.gif",
  frames = 100,
  delay = 0.08,
  width = 640,
  height = 640,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Result of food_web_dynamics().

file

Path of the GIF to write.

frames

Number of frames, taken at evenly spaced rows of x; it cannot exceed the number of rows.

delay

Seconds between frames.

width, height

Size of the GIF in pixels.

...

Other arguments of plot.food_web(), such as panels or colours.

Value

The path of the GIF, invisibly.

See also

plot.food_web()

Other coevolution in food webs: food_web_dynamics(), food_web_params(), plot.food_web()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("gifski", quietly = TRUE)) {
  x <- food_web_dynamics(seq(0, 3000, by = 30), dt = 0.5)
  gif <- animate_food_web(x, tempfile(fileext = ".gif"), frames = 30)
  file.exists(gif)
}
